# KawaHive & Partners

> KawaHive & Partners provides go-to-market (GTM) strategy for founders with registered MedTech and medical devices in APAC: hospital demand, distributor sell-through and purchase orders. KawaHive helps manufacturers understand hospital buying decisions, prioritise target accounts and convert customer interest into documented purchasing progress.

## Who KawaHive supports

KawaHive supports founders and leadership teams with registered products in MedTech and medical devices who need to strengthen customer demand, market focus, distributor performance or conversion from hospital interest to orders.

KawaHive & Partners is a new advisory practice built on more than 20 years of industry experience across MedTech and medical devices in Asia-Pacific. The practice draws on prior professional roles with organisations including GE Healthcare, Fujifilm, Pentax and Konica Minolta. These are previous industry backgrounds, not KawaHive client engagements.

## What KawaHive helps manufacturers do

- Prioritise APAC markets, clinical segments and customer groups.
- Define an ideal customer profile (ICP) and select target hospital or account types.
- Understand clinical-user needs, department priorities and hospital buying behaviour.
- Map stakeholders, including clinical users, department heads, biomedical engineering, procurement and budget holders.
- Clarify product positioning and value proposition for relevant customer groups.
- Assess distributor capability, account coverage, performance and sell-through.
- Identify why demonstrations, evaluations and trials are not progressing to purchase orders.
- Build a focused go-to-market action plan with owners, next steps and evidence.
- Review progress and make evidence-informed decisions to continue, change or stop an approach.

## Market segments

KawaHive's industry experience across MedTech and medical devices includes:
- Radiology and medical imaging
- Surgery
- Obstetrics and gynaecology (OBGYN)
- Urology
- Rehabilitation
- Gastroenterology and endoscopy

## Offers

### Free 30-Minute GTM Clarity Call

A no-obligation 30-minute online call to understand the manufacturer's situation and assess whether KawaHive is a suitable fit. If the fit is appropriate, KawaHive reviews the information the manufacturer chooses to share and prepares a high-level GTM action plan in approximately one week, depending on the information provided. The manufacturer keeps the plan and may implement it independently. If KawaHive is not the right fit, KawaHive will recommend someone better suited at no cost.

### 10-Week Go-to-Market Sprint

Price: US$3,500 fixed fee.

A structured, dedicated engagement for manufacturers with registered products in MedTech and medical devices. It includes one 60-minute online session each week for 10 weeks and focuses on one primary go-to-market challenge. Work covers diagnosis, prioritisation, action planning, execution review and evidence-informed adjustments. Sales, funding, regulatory approval and market-entry outcomes are not guaranteed. Any work beyond the 10-week scope is separately scoped and priced before it begins.

## Important boundaries

KawaHive provides go-to-market strategy and business support. It is not a regulatory consultancy and does not provide clinical, medical, technical certification, legal or investment advice. Content is general information. KawaHive does not guarantee sales, funding, regulatory approval, introductions or market-entry outcomes.

## Geographic scope

KawaHive focuses on APAC go-to-market strategy for registered products in MedTech and medical devices. APAC is not a single uniform market; country-specific purchasing, procurement, distributor and market-entry conditions should be validated for each target market.
